name: Dhofar desert near Marmul (AMADEE-18)
used_by: Austrian Space Forum AMADEE-18 Mars analog mission with rovers and life-detection experiments (February 2018)
notes: Coordinates of Marmul; the field site is in the desert of Dhofar governorate around it.

name: Makhtesh Ramon (AMADEE-20, D-MARS)
used_by: Austrian Space Forum AMADEE-20 Mars analog mission with the Israel Space Agency and D-MARS (2018, 2021)
notes: Erosion cirque 40 km long in the Negev desert; habitat on the crater floor.

name: Northern Sahara near Erfoud (MARS2013)
used_by: Austrian Space Forum and Ibn Battuta Centre: MARS2013 integrated Mars analogue field simulation (February 2013)
notes: Coordinates of Erfoud; the field sites lie in the stony desert around it.

name: Armash plateau (AMADEE-24)
used_by: Austrian Space Forum AMADEE-24 Mars analog mission with the Armenian Aerospace Agency, 13 experiments with rovers and robotics (March-April 2024)
notes: Coordinates of Armash village in Ararat province.

name: Lava Beds National Monument, Medicine Lake volcano
used_by: NASA BRAILLE: CaveR rover and life detection in lava tubes for Mars and the Moon (2019); Apollo astronaut geology training at Medicine Lake (September 1965)
notes: More than 750 lava tubes on the north flank of Medicine Lake volcano.

name: Newberry volcano, Central Oregon
used_by: NASA: Apollo astronaut geology and suit training at Newberry crater, Lava Butte and the obsidian flow (1964-1966)
notes: Caldera with obsidian and basalt flows south of Bend.

name: Lofoten anorthosites, Flakstadoya
used_by: ESA PANGAEA: astronaut training in lunar highland geology on the anorthosite complex (2019-2025)
notes: Nusfjord area; the cell is partly sea.

name: Licancabur volcano summit lake
used_by: NASA Astrobiology Institute and SETI Institute High Lakes Project: analog of Martian paleolakes (2002-2008)
notes: Lake at 5900 m on the Bolivia-Chile border.
